title: tenant billing + trace correlation and synthetic SLO replay harness
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add tenant-level token attribution via trace tags, new per-tenant token-latency histograms, synthetic SLO replay job and a dashboard for billing/latency reconciliation
description: Motivation: customers and billing need a single source-of-truth that ties token costs to traces so we can attribute spend to tenants, models and rollout variants and detect regressions early. This PR adds trace-tag propagation for tenant_id/model_variant/batch_size/cold_start, exposes tenant-scoped token-latency histograms, and ships a synthetic SLO replay harness that replays representative prompts to validate per-tenant alerting and SLOs before rolling to prod. Design summary: 1) Trace correlation: add deterministic propagation of tenant_id and model_variant as top-level trace attributes (tag keys: tenant.id, model.variant, batch.size, runtime.cold_start) and emit them on span creation points in the serving hot path. 2) Metrics: new Prometheus histograms: redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket{tenant_id,model_variant} and redwood_token_size_total{tenant_id,model_variant}; a derived counter redwood_token_cost_cents_total{tenant_id} computed in the metrics pipeline to support near-real-time billing dashboards. 3) Synthetic SLO replay: a Kubernetes CronJob (synthetic-replay) that replays tenant-specific prompt sets at configurable qps and records golden-trace fingerprints to detect quality/latency regressions. 4) Dashboard & runbook: Grafana dashboard 'Tenant Billing & Trace Correlation' with per-tenant tabs, scatter of token-cost vs 99.9p latency, a reconciliation panel that compares expected token cost (from usage) to derived billing. Also added a short runbook section to handle false-positive spikes and rollback steps. Commits summary: - init: add tenant trace tags and metric hooks to serving/runtime entry points - metrics: introduce histograms, expose labels to scrape - pipeline: small adjustment in ingestion mapping to compute derived cost counter - synthetic: add synthetic-replay job and sample prompt sets for two internal tenants - dashboard: add Grafana json, panels and templating variables - tests: unit tests for tag propagation and an integration harness for synthetic job - docs: quickstart for using tenant replay and interpreting reconciliation panels Files changed (high-level): - redwood/serving/src/trace/tags.rs (propagate tenant/model tags and cold_start flag) - redwood/serving/src/hotpath/emit_metrics.rs (emit tenant-scoped histograms; minimal allocations) - redwood/metrics/pipeline/mappings.yml (derive token cost counter) - redwood/infra/k8s/synthetic-replay.yaml (CronJob + image + configmaps) - redwood/observability/dashboards/tenant_billing.json (Grafana JSON dashboard) - redwood/docs/observability/tenant_replay.md (how-to and runbook) - redwood/tests/integration/synthetic_replay_test.py (replay smoke tests) - redwood/tests/unit/trace_tag_tests.rs (unit tests) - redwood/ci/workflows/observability.yml (add synthetic job in e2e matrix) - redwood/console/src/components/CostAttributionPanel.tsx (UI panel wiring) - go/metrics-exporter/README.md (how to pull derived counters) - infra/alerts/tenant_slo_rules.yml (per-tenant 99.9p alert with synthetic verification hook) Review timeline and conversation: - 2026-02-23 Jared Bloom: "Nice direction. Please ensure tag propagation is zero-copy on the hot path and add benchmarks. Also prefer tenant_id as opaque string not numeric casted everywhere." Author (Aisha): "Addressed: switched to Cow<'static, str> storage for tags and added micro-bench harness. Updated tests accordingly." - 2026-02-24 Samir Gupta: "Synthetic job looks promising. We should gate high-qps tenants behind a feature flag to avoid billing surprises during rollout." Author: "Added feature flag synthetic.replay.enabled and defaults off for prod in k8s manifest. Added docs." - 2026-02-25 Marta Chen: "Alerting: aggregation over tenant cardinality may blow up. Add rate-limited alerting and a sliding window for 99.9p." Author: "Implemented slidingWindow(10m) + dynamic thresholding and a secondary alert that triggers only if synthetic replay also shows regression." - 2026-02-27 CI: initial run failed (lint errors in dashboard json and a formatting issue in metrics mapping). Author fixed formatting and re-ran. - 2026-02-28 CI: tests: small flake in synthetic-replay integration due to timeouts; increased retry in harness. - 2026-03-02 Review approvals: Jared: approved after benchmarks added; Samir: approves after feature-flag gating; Marta: approved pending small doc tweak which was pushed. Rollout plan & safety: - Rollout will be staged: feature flag off in production by default. Enable for internal-account sandbox and two low-traffic tenants for 48h, monitor token-cost vs expected and 99.9 latency. - If synthetic job shows divergence or reconciliation panel shows >5% mismatch for a tenant for 2 consecutive windows, automatic rollback to previous model_variant via rollout policy will be triggered (documented in runbook). Backcompat & migrations: - New metric labels add cardinality. To protect TSDB we: 1) shard tenant label cardinality by default to active tenants only via metrics sampling rules; 2) recommend on-prem customers enable sampling. See metrics/pipeline/mappings.yml for limits. Testing & performance: - Added microbench harness for tag propagation (no measurable increase in p50 token latency on small runs). - Unit + integration tests added and synthetic replay smoke tests included in CI e2e matrix. Observability & alert tuning: - New alerts: tenant_token_latency_high (99.9p sliding window with synthetic verification) and tenant_billing_reconciliation_mismatch (percentage delta between expected vs derived cost). - Dashboards: templated per-tenant view and a global reconciliation heatmap. - Added short-runbook: steps to mute false positives, inspect traces, re-run synthetic replay, and rollback rollout policies. CI status: final green on 2026-03-03 after fixing lint and increasing replay retries. Merge: squashed and merged by Marta Chen 2026-03-03. Notes and caveats: - We intentionally kept metric emission inlined in hotpath with careful allocation avoidance; maintainers should avoid heavy allocations when modifying emit_metrics.rs. - Cardinality controls are conservative; ops can tune sampling for large enterprise customers. - Synthetic prompt sets are not exhaustive — intended to catch regressions, not replace full evals. Related: ENG-4721 (billing attribution epic), ENG-4830 (slo automation).
